subject: pharmacology
title: Vitamins and dermatology drugs: retinoids, hair, pigment and sun

steps.tx: Fat soluble **vitamin A** prevents night blindness and Bitot spots and reduces measles mortality in deficient children. Excess vitamin A damages the fetus, so pregnancy forbids high dose supplements without specialist advice and monitoring. **Vitamin D** deficiency softens growing bones in rickets and adult bones in osteomalacia across deficient populations worldwide. Excess vitamin D raises calcium and produces thirst, polyuria and kidney stones in supplement abusers taking megadoses. Newborn intramuscular vitamin K prevents late bleeding from vitamin K deficiency in infancy reliably.
steps.say: Fat soluble vitamins prevent deficiency disease but excess intake damages organs in predictable patterns that examinations test repeatedly today. Night blindness improves with replacement while excess intake damages the fetus during pregnancy without specialist supervision and monitoring provided. Deficiency softens growing bones in children and adult bones in older patients across deficient populations living worldwide in winter. Excess intake raises calcium and produces thirst with kidney stones in supplement abusers taking megadoses over months together. Newborn injections prevent late bleeding from deficiency in infancy reliably across maternity units everywhere in practice.

steps.tx: This wrist radiograph shows the classic growth plate changes of **rickets** at the distal radius and ulna. The physis looks widened while the metaphysis shows **cupping** and fraying instead of a clean mineralised edge. Poor vitamin D dependent mineralisation leaves uncalcified cartilage piling up at the fastest growing end of bone. A toddler with bowed legs and delayed dentition should bring this exact film to mind in paediatric stems. Treatment replaces vitamin D and calcium and the plate remineralises over following months.
steps.say: This wrist radiograph shows classic growth plate changes at the distal radius in a growing child with bone disease. The growth plate looks widened while the bone end shows cupping and fraying instead of a clean mineralised edge visible. Poor mineralisation leaves uncalcified cartilage piling up at the fastest growing end of bone in deficient children untreated over months. A toddler with bowed legs should bring this exact film to mind in paediatric examination stems presented with radiographs attached. Treatment replaces the deficient vitamin and calcium and the plate remineralises over following months of therapy given.

steps.tx: **Thiamine** deficiency produces Wernicke syndrome with confusion, ataxia and ophthalmoplegia in malnourished alcoholic patients presenting acutely. Clinicians always give thiamine before glucose because glucose alone can precipitate brain injury in that setting suddenly. Isoniazid treatment needs **pyridoxine** cover because the drug otherwise causes peripheral neuropathy in slow acetylators on therapy. Niacin deficiency produces pellagra with dermatitis, dementia and diarrhoea in maize dependent diets lacking tryptophan diversity historically. Riboflavin deficiency cracks the mouth corners and inflames the tongue in poor diets.
steps.say: Thiamine deficiency produces confusion, ataxia and eye movement failure in malnourished alcoholic patients presenting acutely to emergency departments. Clinicians always give thiamine before glucose because glucose alone can precipitate brain injury in that setting suddenly without warning signs. Isoniazid treatment needs vitamin cover because the drug otherwise causes peripheral neuropathy in patients on prolonged tuberculosis therapy courses. Niacin deficiency produces dermatitis, dementia and diarrhoea in maize dependent diets lacking dietary diversity in poor communities historically worldwide. Mouth cracks and tongue inflammation complete the deficiency patterns that examinations test in nutrition stems every year regularly.

steps.tx: **Vitamin C** deficiency causes scurvy with corkscrew hairs, bleeding gums and poor wound healing in restricted diets. The vitamin also improves iron absorption, while excess intake promotes kidney stones in susceptible patients taking megadoses daily. **Isotretinoin** clears severe acne but it damages the fetus severely, so strict pregnancy prevention programmes govern every prescription issued. Treatment dries skin and lips and raises lipids, so laboratory monitoring accompanies each course in dermatology clinics. Tretinoin differentiates leukaemia cells in acute promyelocytic disease and can trigger a breathless differentiation syndrome.
steps.say: Vitamin deficiency causes bleeding gums and corkscrew hairs with poor wound healing in restricted diets eaten over months. The vitamin improves iron absorption while excess intake promotes kidney stones in susceptible patients taking megadoses every day unnecessarily. One retinoid clears severe acne but damages the fetus severely so strict pregnancy prevention governs every prescription issued in clinics. Treatment dries skin and lips and raises lipids so laboratory monitoring accompanies each course in dermatology follow up visits. Another retinoid differentiates leukaemia cells and can trigger a breathless syndrome needing steroids in hospital care settings.

steps.tx: **Minoxidil** grows hair but it first sheds resting hairs and rarely causes pericardial fluid accumulation around the heart. **Finasteride** blocks androgen conversion for hair loss and prostate symptoms, yet pregnant handling risks fetal genital harm at home. The drug halves measured prostate antigen levels, so clinicians double the value when screening treated men for cancer accurately. Hydroquinone lightens melasma but prolonged misuse causes exogenous ochronosis with paradoxical darkening of treated facial skin areas. Sunscreen with regular reapplication protects every pigment treatment from ultraviolet relapse.
steps.say: One hair drug grows hair but first sheds resting hairs and rarely causes fluid around the heart in patients. Another drug blocks androgen conversion yet pregnant handling risks fetal harm so households store it carefully away safely. That drug halves measured prostate marker levels so clinicians double the value when screening treated men for cancer accurately. Lightening cream can paradoxically darken skin after prolonged misuse on the face without medical supervision and sun protection used. Sunscreen with regular reapplication protects every pigment treatment from ultraviolet relapse during Indian summer months outdoors daily.
